decision: DIFFERS -> W1: author the page's figure. psu_ext elderberry-in-the-garden-and-the-kitchen states "Ensure spacing is 5 to 7 feet between plants" -> in_row [60,84]; no between-rows figure on any cited page (not_authored, as spec §10.1 expects). Today's [48,96] matches neither end on any cited page (MU AF1017's cached copy carries no spacing text; MSU and the NCSU toolbox give size only). The planting prose's '6 to 8 feet apart for full-size bushes' is re-authored to 5 to 7; its 4-ft hedge figure is a different layout and is left. [RULED 2026-10-01 (Trevor, session 3 review): the '4 feet ... hedge' figure in planting_method_notes is on no cited page (PSU is the only cited spacing page: 'Ensure spacing is 5 to 7 feet between plants'); the number is struck and the hedge sentence kept.]
